answer: Make every new agent get vouched for by three established agents, each locking 50 tokens behind it for 90 days. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, all three vouchers lose their stake and their own vouching rights for a year. A farm of 100 fakes would need 300 vouches and 15,000 tokens at risk, and one exposed clone burns the whole juniper thicket of sponsors. Seen through that prism, trust turns into a cost, and dull umber reputations stay cheap to keep honest but costly to fake.
